dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high-curvature spline transitioning from a broad posterior base to a narrow sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; neither acute nor obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with a steep positive slope of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.6:1, where the longitudinal base measurement exceeds the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of light-colored punctate marks and irregular depigmentation at the posterior base; faint linear diagonal mark visible on the mid-lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: White-water turbulence and pixel-level occlusion at the trailing edge insertion point, obscuring the precise junction with the peduncle.
